corpus.text: Photosynthesis converts sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen in plant leaves.
A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape.
The Roman Empire fell in the west in 476 AD after centuries of expansion, trade and military campaigns.
Vaccines train the immune system by exposing it to a harmless form of a pathogen, building lasting immunity.
Ocean tides are caused mainly by the gravitational pull of the Moon and, to a lesser extent, the Sun.

description: Phase 2 retrieval eval dataset (v1). Five queries over a five-document corpus. The eval test simulates an embedding ranking that puts the expected document at vector rank 3 (not 1) and asserts the hybrid pipeline still recovers it in the top 3 for at least 4 of 5 queries (recall@3 >= 0.8). Thresholds are deliberately modest for v1: they guard against regressions in fusion/reranking, they do not claim production-grade recall on real corpora.
